currentRoundInspection.method: Two linked aerial photographs visually inspected; standard viewer PMTiles control approximate plan and hillside fit. No bespoke survey/history research.
observations: Four hollow round corner towers surround an open grassy court. The inner curtain is high and nearly rectangular; a much lower concentric curtain has small round projections.

The roofless gatehouse has two broad exterior drums, two smaller rear stair turrets, a central arched passage and broken upper walls with large genuine window openings. Low room ruins line the opposite side of the court.

A narrow modern curved footbridge enters the eastern gate from the visitor side across the rocky approach. A small light covered entrance is visible; exact glazing, truss/support and deck heights are not resolved by these aerial pictures.
currentRoundInspection.usage: Linked evidence only; photographs are not redistributed or embedded as textures.
